text_en: Bezalel and Oholiab and every skillful one to whom the Lord has given skill and understanding to know how to do any work in the construction of the sanctuary shall work in accordance with all that the Lord has commanded.
text_cn: 贝匝肋耳和敖曷里雅布以及所有各种技工，即上主赐给他们才能智慧为明了做圣所的一切工程的人，全按照上主所吩咐的一切去做。

text_en: Moses then called Bezalel and Oholiab and every skillful one to whom the Lord had given skill, everyone whose heart was stirred to come to do the work;
text_cn: 梅瑟将贝匝肋耳和敖曷里雅布以及上主赐给他们才能的一切技工，并所有心甘情愿前来工作的人，都叫了来。

text_en: and they received from Moses all the freewill offerings that the Israelites had brought for doing the work on the sanctuary. They still kept bringing him freewill offerings every morning,
text_cn: 他们当着梅瑟的面，接收了以色列子民为建造圣所的各种工程送来的一切献仪。但以色列子民仍天天早晨将自愿的献仪送来；

text_en: so that all the artisans who were doing every sort of task on the sanctuary came, each from the task being performed,
text_cn: 因此建造圣所各种工程的技工，人人都停止他们所做的工程，

text_en: and said to Moses, “The people are bringing much more than enough for doing the work that the Lord has commanded us to do. ”
text_cn: 来向梅瑟说：“百姓送来的太多，已超过上主命令为完成这工程所需要的。”

text_en: So Moses gave command, and word was proclaimed throughout the camp: “No man or woman is to make anything else as an offering for the sanctuary. ” So the people were restrained from bringing;
text_cn: 梅瑟遂吩咐在营中传令说：“无论男女，不必再为圣所的工程送献仪。”百姓这才停止不送。

text_en: for what they had already brought was more than enough to do all the work.
text_cn: 送来的材料足够全工程之用，而且有余。

text_en: All those with skill among the workers made the tabernacle with ten curtains; they were made of fine twisted linen, and blue, purple, and crimson yarns, with cherubim skillfully worked into them.
text_cn: 在作工的人中，最有技术的工人用十幅布幔做了帐棚；布幔是用捻的细麻，紫色、红色、朱红色的毛线做的，用绣工绣上革鲁宾。

text_en: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits; all the curtains were of the same size.
text_cn: 每幅布幔长二十八肘，宽四肘；每幅布幔都是一样的尺寸。

text_en: He joined five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he joined to one another.
text_cn: 五幅布幔相连缝在一起，另五幅相连缝在一起。

text_en: He made loops of blue on the edge of the outermost curtain of the first set; likewise he made them on the edge of the outermost curtain of the second set;
text_cn: 在这一组布幔末幅的边上做了紫色的钮，在另一组布幔末幅的边上也照样做了；

text_en: he made fifty loops on the one curtain, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was in the second set; the loops were opposite one another.
text_cn: 在这一幅上做了五十个钮，在另一组布幔末幅的边上，也做了五十个钮；这些钮都彼此相对。

text_en: And he made fifty clasps of gold, and joined the curtains one to the other with clasps; so the tabernacle was one whole.
text_cn: 又做了五十个金钩，用金钩使布幔彼此相连，这样成了一个帐棚。

text_en: He also made curtains of goats’ hair for a tent over the tabernacle; he made eleven curtains.
text_cn: 又用山羊毛做了布幔，作帐棚顶用，共做了十一幅布幔，

text_en: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits; the eleven curtains were of the same size.
text_cn: 每幅长三十肘，宽四肘；十一幅布幔都是一样的尺寸。

text_en: He joined five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
text_cn: 将五幅布幔缝在一起，

text_en: He made fifty loops on the edge of the outermost curtain of the one set, and fifty loops on the edge of the other connecting curtain.
text_cn: 将另六幅也缝在一起；在这一组布幔末幅的边上做了五十个钮，在另一组布幔末幅的一边上，也做了五十个钮；

text_en: He made fifty clasps of bronze to join the tent together so that it might be one whole.
text_cn: 又制了五十个铜钩，使棚顶连结在一起，成为一个。

text_en: And he made for the tent a covering of tanned rams’ skins and an outer covering of fine leather.
text_cn: 以后用染红的公羊皮作了棚顶的罩，上边又蒙上一块海豚皮的罩。

text_en: Then he made the upright frames for the tabernacle of acacia wood.
text_cn: 为支帐棚，用皂荚木做了竖立的木板。

text_en: Ten cubits was the length of a frame, and a cubit and a half the width of each frame.
text_cn: 每块木板高十肘，宽一肘半。

text_en: Each frame had two pegs for fitting together; he did this for all the frames of the tabernacle.
text_cn: 每块木板下有两个榫（sǔn）头彼此并列；帐棚的一切木板，都是这样做。

text_en: The frames for the tabernacle he made in this way: twenty frames for the south side;
text_cn: 支帐棚的木板，在向阳的一面，即南边，做了二十块木板；

text_en: and he made forty bases of silver under the twenty frames, two bases under the first frame for its two pegs, and two bases under the next frame for its two pegs.
text_cn: 在二十块木板下边做了四十个银卯（mǎo）座，每块木板下两个银卯（mǎo）座，为安木板的两榫（sǔn）头。

text_en: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty frames
text_cn: 为帐棚的另一面，即北边，也做了二十块木板，

text_en: and their forty bases of silver, two bases under the first frame and two bases under the next frame.
text_cn: 也做了四十个银卯（mǎo）座，每块木板下两个卯（mǎo）座。

text_en: For the rear of the tabernacle westward he made six frames.
text_cn: 为帐棚的后面，即西边做了六块木板。

text_en: He made two frames for corners of the tabernacle in the rear.
text_cn: 在帐棚的后面的两角上，做了两块木板，

text_en: They were separate beneath, but joined at the top, at the first ring; he made two of them in this way, for the two corners.
text_cn: 木板下端是双的，直到上端第一环都是双的；两块木板都照样做了，形成两个角。

text_en: There were eight frames with their bases of silver: sixteen bases, under every frame two bases.
text_cn: 所以共有八块木板，十六个银卯（mǎo）座，每块板下两个卯（mǎo）座。

text_en: He made bars of acacia wood, five for the frames of the one side of the tabernacle,
text_cn: 又用皂荚木做了横木为帐棚这一面木板做了五根，

text_en: and five bars for the frames of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the frames of the tabernacle at the rear westward.
text_cn: 为帐棚另一面木板，也做了五根横木，为帐棚后面即西边的木板，也做了五根横木。

text_en: He made the middle bar to pass through from end to end halfway up the frames.
text_cn: 又做了木板中间的那根横木，从这头穿到那头。

text_en: And he overlaid the frames with gold, and made rings of gold for them to hold the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
text_cn: 木板上包了金；做了穿横木的金环，横木上也包了金。

text_en: He made the curtain of blue, purple, and crimson yarns, and fine twisted linen, with cherubim skillfully worked into it.
text_cn: 随后用紫色、红色、朱红色的毛线和捻的细麻，做了一个帐幔，用绣工绣上革鲁宾。

text_en: For it he made four pillars of acacia, and overlaid them with gold; their hooks were of gold, and he cast for them four bases of silver.
text_cn: 为挂帐幔做了四根皂荚木柱子，包上金，柱钉是金的，又铸了四个银卯（mǎo）座。

text_en: He also made a screen for the entrance to the tent, of blue, purple, and crimson yarns, and fine twisted linen, embroidered with needlework;
text_cn: 又做了会幕的门帘，是用紫色、红色、朱红色的毛线和捻的细麻编成的。

text_en: and its five pillars with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their bases with gold, but their five bases were of bronze.
text_cn: 为挂门帘，又做了五根柱子和柱钉，柱帽和横棍包了金；又作了五个铜卯（mǎo）座。
